title: The counter left before the creature died
era: 2006 World Championship Standard representative Boros aggro game
matchup: Boros aggro against green mana acceleration
story: My Icatian Javelineers had entered last turn with one javelin counter. During my opponent's main phase I tapped it and removed that counter, targeting their Llanowar Elves . My opponent answered with Shock , destroying the Javelineers while its ability remained on the stack. The ability still resolved and dealt one damage to the Elves, so the 1/1 died too. I still had Lightning Helix in hand, but I did not need to spend it on the mana creature. If I had just cast Javelineers this turn, its tap activation would not have been available yet.
review: Javelineers under controller since preceding turn; tap and remove one counter as costs. Opponent Shock destroys Javelineers after activation; its damage ability persists and kills 1/1 Llanowar Elves. Hypothetical opponent, 2006 period card pool.
claim: representative reconstruction; not a historical match or quotation
